name: session-deck
description: A live deck for your Claude Code session: model, context, usage limits, git branch and worktree, open PRs and todos, in a band above the prompt and a side pane.

position.title: Where to show the deck
position.description: band: colored rows above the prompt (recommended). status: one plain line under the prompt, no colors. both: the band plus that line.

showDirectory.title: Show the working directory
showDirectory.description: Next to the branch, shortened from the left when long so the nearest folders stay.

showPrs.title: Show open pull requests
showPrs.description: Lists open PRs of the repository. Needs the GitHub CLI (gh) signed in; without it only this section says so.

warnPercent.title: Warn when the context is this full (%)
warnPercent.description: A toast appears once when the context window passes this percent. Default 80.

compactHintPercent.title: Suggest /compact from (%)
compactHintPercent.description: From this context percent the band suggests /compact or a new session and shows what each request costs to re-read. Default 50.

cacheTtl.title: Prompt cache lifetime
cacheTtl.description: 1h or 5m. Drives the cache countdown. Claude Code sessions normally cache for an hour, so 1h is the default; pick 5m only if your setup caches for five minutes. A /model switch lets Claude Code report the real value, which is then remembered and wins over this.

notifyAfterSeconds.title: Notify after a long message (seconds)
notifyAfterSeconds.description: When a message takes at least this long you get a toast and a system notification when it finishes. 0 turns it off. Default 60.

briefing.title: Briefing when a session starts
briefing.description: Prints one line when a session starts: branch, uncommitted changes, open PRs and whether a handoff note is waiting.

notifyOnPermission.title: Notify when Claude waits for you
notifyOnPermission.description: A notification when Claude asks for a permission or an answer and is stuck until you reply.

confirmModelSwitchAtTokens.title: Ask before /model above (tokens)
confirmModelSwitchAtTokens.description: When the context is at least this big and the cache is warm, /model asks first, because switching throws the cache away. 0 turns it off. Default 100000.
